name: TC-RENEWAL-011: Search Renewal Listing with Non-Existent Subscription ID
description: Search with a non-existent 10-digit Subscription ID ('0000000000') and verify empty state display.
descriptionHtml: Search with a non-existent 10-digit Subscription ID ('0000000000') and verify empty state display.

steps.name: Class Setup: Authenticate & Initialize Renewal Session

testStage.description: Search with a non-existent 10-digit Subscription ID ('0000000000') and verify empty state display.

steps.name: 1. Switch to 'All' Tab Prior to Search
2. Enter Non-Existent ID '0000000000' in Search Bar
3. Assert Non-Existent ID Yields Empty Results or No Matching Row
4. Scan for Errors on Empty Search State

labels.name: feature
labels.value: Renewal Dashboard, Lead Follow-Up & History Flow
